title: Plugin Resources Response Schema
description: Schema for the admin/data-access/plugin-resource-types/{typeCode}/resources endpoint: the resources of one plugin resource type (H6). A caller who is not a superuser gets only the items they hold the view grant on (C9, F232).

id.description: Resource id, used as resource_id in role permissions

can_assign.description: The caller holds every grant bit of this item and may therefore hand it out (rule 4.6f)
